{{Top}}
{{Image}}
The '''tractor beam targeting array''' was a feature of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]]. Sitting on top of the command tower, between the two [[ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome|ISD-72x]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] domes.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> With the rise of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class]] ships, the tractor beam targeting array was replaced by a [[Communications tower/Legends|communications tower]].<ref name="SpecPlate">[["Imperial Star Destroyer" SpecPlate]]</ref>
